LIBERO steps the controller at 20 Hz but merged_kpt info.json declares fps=10, with no frame resampled (273465 frames on both sides). This is harmless to the model because every window is addressed by frame index, not seconds; it is only wrong when a human (or a mixed-fps dataset) reads those windows as physical time.
